observation: The newly introduced strict TextDecoder default stripped a leading UTF-8 BOM, changing repository text relative to the previous byte-to-string behavior even though the bytes were valid.
pre_fix_reproduction: A BOM-prefixed bom.js decoded with first code point U+0061 instead of U+FEFF in both read() and contextBundle().
change: Set TextDecoder ignoreBOM=true so strict UTF-8 validation rejects malformed bytes while preserving an explicit BOM code point and raw byte accounting.
truth_boundary: This preserves UTF-8 BOM semantics only; no claim is made for automatic transcoding of UTF-16 or legacy encodings.
